# construct 28x28 tiled board; separators lines at every 5th index, cell 4x4 then last 3
n=28
out=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
# paint blocks grid r,c with cell block boundaries (5*r to +4), clipped
colors={}
# 2 horizontal row1 c0..4
for c in range(5): colors[(1,c)]=2
# 2 vertical c0 r1..3
for r in range(1,4): colors[(r,0)]=2
# 3 vertical col2 rows0..4
for r in range(5): colors[(r,2)] = colors.get((r,2),0)+3
# recompute crossing specifically 6, color sum 2+3+1? if color value combine special
colors[(1,2)]=6
for (br,bc),v in colors.items():
  # colored paths only in cells; separators remain 8; block ranges
  for rr in range(br*5, min(br*5+4,n)):
    for cc in range(bc*5,min(bc*5+4,n)):
      out[rr][cc]=v
# separator lines
for k in [4,9,14,19,24]:
  for i in range(n): out[k][i]=8; out[i][k]=8
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
